front_block.doc: Front rail mount: the block that fixes the front (SMEMA: fixed) rail to a cross beam's top. Machined aluminium.

pulley.doc: Belt pulley: the flanged roller the flat belt wraps, at each rail's ends (idlers on axles) and below

rail.doc: Transport rail: the machined aluminium bar each belt runs along (one fixed at the front, one moving at the rear).

rear_carriage.doc: Rear rail carriage: carries the moving rear rail on a linear guide block and takes the lead screw's nut, so turning
